purpose: Bind one semantic stream to the exact native Stage1 candidate artifact and fixture that produced it.
hash_policy: Validator recomputes SHA-256 and byte sizes from the supplied candidate source, candidate binary, fixture source, and S3IR2 stream. Declared metadata alone is insufficient.
qualification_rule: Final S3IR2 v2 laboratory qualification requires native provenance PASS in addition to structural PASS, strict S3 semantic conformance PASS, and deterministic repeated stream bytes.
